responsibility: Defines the detailed automaton-based pipeline model for the Motorola/Freescale PowerPC 8540 and 8548 cores. It represents decode, issue, retire, branch, scalar, multiply, divide, load/store, floating-point, and vector/SPE-style resources and uses them to give GCC’s scheduler latency and structural hazard information for the ppc8540/ppc8548 embedded cores.
